description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for cart-related data in an online shopping platform, including classes for cart summaries, cart items, and update requests, with JSON serialization annotations.

classes.name: CartDto
classes.description: Represents the shopping cart with optional identifiers, user info, list of items, and summary totals.

classes.name: CartItemDto
classes.description: Details of an individual item in the cart, including product info, quantity, price, and category.

classes.name: CartItemMutationRequestDto
classes.description: Request DTO for mutating (adding/updating) a cart item, including product details and quantity.

classes.name: CartUpdateQuantityRequestDto
classes.description: Request DTO to update the quantity of a specific product in the cart.
